sentences.japanese: 君の本は私の本の２倍の大きさだ。
sentences.english: Your book is double the size of mine.

sentences.japanese: 君の部屋は私の部屋の２倍の広さがある。
sentences.english: Your room is twice the size of mine.

sentences.japanese: 君の収入は僕の収入の約２倍だ。
sentences.english: Your income is about twice as large as mine.

sentences.japanese: 君の収入は私の収入の２倍だ。
sentences.english: Your income is about twice as large as mine is.
Your income is three times larger than mine.
